purpose: Source/population identification using a bounded numerical fingerprint; not a full GWAS reproduction
population: All 529 accessions retained in the published 533-accession panel after exclusion of four accessions; not the combined 1479-accession panel or the 3K cohort
precision: Exact NMISS; BETA, STAT and P matched to the 4-significant-digit precision retained in the local PLINK output
reconstruction: OLS with an intercept and additive 0/2 dosage for homozygous effect-allele counts; nonmissing imputed genotypes; phenotype -9 excluded; two-sided t test with n-2 degrees of freedom; no covariates
limitations: Bounded fingerprint does not independently validate every SNP or recover the historical PLINK command/version.
Portal precomputed LR/LMM P-values are not the local unadjusted PLINK ADD output; a difference alone does not refute source-population identity.
One of five queried markers (vg0503927501) has deletion/multi-allelic display calls and was not recoded for reconstruction.
